title: Niagara-on-the-Lake Guided Food Tour with Ice Wine & Poutine
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
This is a walking tour. Guests should be able to walk at a moderate pace without difficulty.
We are able to accommodate guests with mobility impairment or wheelchairs, please make sure to email our Guest Experience team at info@walks.org at the time of your booking for proper arrangements.
This tour is not recommended for Vegans, lactose intolerant, peanut free.

This tour is adaptable for: Vegetarian, Gluten free (not celiac), Dairy free, Pescatarian, and Pregnant women, however, please note that you may not have a replacement food option at every stop. Not recommended for vegans, dairy free, or celiacs.
policies: This tour covers a full meal.
Guests with serious food allergies will need to sign an allergy waiver at the start of the tour.
Those with dietary restrictions need to contact us before joining the tour so we can arrange your food, or we may not be able to accommodate you.
Please note: This tour offers multiple options. Take a moment to choose the one that best suits your interests.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover Niagara-on-the-Lake through its most iconic flavors on this small-group food and walking tour. Stroll through the charming streets as your expert guide leads you to six curated stops, including a private maple syrup tasting, buttery tarts, savory poutine, and sweet ice wine. Along the way, enjoy fascinating stories—ever hear of the Great Canadian Maple Syrup Heist?—and generous tastes of the foods you can't leave Canada without trying. Perfect for food lovers wanting to fully round out their Canadian culinary experience! Prefer a private tour? Select the Private Niagara-on-the-Lake Food Tour at time of booking to enjoy iconic local bites with a dedicated guide for only your party.
